# Cursor IDE Blog

> > Comprehensive guides and tutorials for AI-powered development tools, focusing on Claude, ChatGPT, and code generation workflows.

Cursor IDE Blog provides in-depth technical guides, pricing comparisons, and optimization strategies for AI development tools including Claude API, ChatGPT, and AI coding assistants. The site specializes in practical tutorials for developers, cost-saving methods, and integration guides with a focus on the Chinese developer community.
